title: gymnadenia odoratissima
intro: Gymnadenia odoratissima, commonly known as the Fragrant Gymnadenia, is a species of orchid native to Europe. It is a perennial herb with a rich history in traditional medicine, valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Gymnadenia odoratissima include its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and bronchodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
